snippet.text: (∃ m > 0, ∀ p ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ Ioo a b, m * weight c a b y ≤ ‖T (p,y)‖) ∧ (∀ n, ∃ C > 0, ∃ N, ∀ i ≤ n, ∀ p ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ Ioo a b, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i T (p,y)‖ ≤ C * weight c a b y / edgeDistance a b y ^ N) ∧ (the same in the radial chart), where weight c a b y = FlatCutoff.edge c (y-a) * FlatCutoff.edge 4 (b-y) and edgeDistance a b y = min 1 (min (y-a) (b-y))
